title: oxydectes laevifolia
intro: Oxydectes laevifolia, commonly known as Smooth False Daisy, is a flowering plant species in the daisy family. The plant is known for its potential health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of Oxydectes laevifolia include reducing inflammation, fighting against bacterial and fungal infections, and exhibiting antimicrobial and antiviral activities. The bioactive constituents responsible for its therapeutic actions are yet to be fully identified, but it is believed to contain flavonoids, glycosides, and other secondary metabolites.
